class Settings:
    def __init__(self, html):
        self.where = html.request.var("where")
        self.alias = html.request.get_unicode_input("alias", "").strip() or None
        self.recurse = html.get_checkbox("recurse")
        self.select = html.request.var("select")
        self.timeout = utils.saveint(html.request.var("timeout")) or 8
        self.probes = utils.saveint(html.request.var("probes")) or 2
        self.max_ttl = utils.saveint(html.request.var("max_ttl")) or 10
        self.force_explicit = html.get_checkbox("force_explicit")
        self.ping_probes = utils.saveint(html.request.var("ping_probes")) or 0


def _from_vars(self):
    self._start = bool(html.request.var("_start"))
    self._all = bool(html.request.var("all"))
    self._complete_folder = self._all

    # Ignored during initial form display
    self._settings = Settings(html)
    self._job = ParentScanBackgroundJob()
